harbor_antrieb_executor.summary: Created the dedicated inventorysvc system account and a systemd service inventory-worker running /usr/local/bin/os-comparison-worker as that user on node1, enabled it, and verified it survives a full node reboot.
actions_performed: Inspected node1: confirmed binary /usr/local/bin/os-comparison-worker exists (a sleep-loop shell script) and neither inventorysvc user nor inventory-worker service existed yet
Created system account inventorysvc (no home, nologin shell) via useradd --system
Wrote /etc/systemd/system/inventory-worker.service with User=inventorysvc, Group=inventorysvc, ExecStart=/usr/local/bin/os-comparison-worker, Restart=on-failure, WantedBy=multi-user.target
Ran systemctl daemon-reload and enabled+started inventory-worker
Verified service active, enabled, and process running under inventorysvc via ps
Captured pre-restart boot_id and service health baseline
Issued a native reboot on node1 via nohup'd sudo reboot so the ack returned before disconnect
Polled node1 until exec connectivity returned
Confirmed boot_id changed (e8afb731... -> 3601e4ff...), proving a real restart occurred
Verified post-restart: inventory-worker enabled and active, process running as inventorysvc, and the inventorysvc account persisted

evidence.requirement: os-comparison-worker runs as managed service inventory-worker under dedicated inventorysvc account
evidence.summary: Confirmed binary and absence of prior user/service, then created inventorysvc, installed and started inventory-worker.service; systemctl status and ps show it active and running as inventorysvc

evidence.requirement: node1 mandatory restart evidence: healthy baseline before restart
evidence.summary: Captured pre-restart boot_id (e8afb731-420c-4162-a989-583aca271335) and confirmed inventory-worker active with process running

evidence.requirement: node1 mandatory restart evidence: restart acknowledgement and disconnect
evidence.summary: Issued backgrounded sudo reboot which returned acknowledgement immediately; subsequent exec call failed with connection reset, confirming the node went down

evidence.requirement: node1 mandatory restart evidence: changed boot identity after restart
evidence.summary: Polling succeeded once node1 came back, returning a new boot_id (3601e4ff-0a6f-4865-b9bc-44d47af33ca9), differing from the pre-restart value, proving an actual reboot

evidence.requirement: node1 mandatory restart evidence: post-restart recovery of service and account
evidence.summary: Post-restart check shows same new boot_id, inventory-worker enabled and active with a fresh process (PID 654) running as inventorysvc, and the inventorysvc account still present
